data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for MapsIndoors indoor mapping using Mapbox.
data.what_it_does: Provides indoor maps, real‑time wayfinding and route rendering via the MapsIndoors SDK on Android and iOS. It wraps native Mapbox maps and adds MapsIndoors-specific controls and services.
use_when: You need indoor mapping and navigation with MapsIndoors on Flutter
You want offline caching of base‑map tiles for Mapbox
You target Android API 21+ and iOS 16+ and can provide Mapbox credentials
avoid_when: You cannot add native Gradle or Podfile changes
You require a different map provider (e.g., Google Maps only)
Your app must support iOS versions below 16
strengths: Full integration with MapsIndoors indoor SDK
Offline base‑map tile caching for Mapbox
weaknesses: Requires native setup: API keys, Maven repo, Gradle token, Podfile changes
Minimum iOS version 16 limits older devices
Tied to Mapbox; cannot switch to other map providers easily
data.setup_notes: Add mapbox_api_key.xml with API key, configure Maven repo and MAPBOX_DOWNLOADS_TOKEN in gradle.properties, set iOS platform to 16.0 and add use_frameworks! in Podfile, provide MBXAccessToken in Info.plist, then add mapsindoors_mapbox to pubspec.
